headline: Linklaters advises on Runwal Enterprises Limited's upcoming IPO in India
hook: Runwal Enterprises prepares for public listing
summary: International law firm Linklaters is advising on the proposed initial public offering of Runwal Enterprises Limited in India. The company is moving forward with its public market debut preparations. Indian retail investors should monitor the draft red herring prospectus for financial details when filed. This listing will add another real estate player to the domestic stock exchanges.
whats_next: Filing of draft papers with SEBI
why_it_matters: New real estate investment option coming to Indian markets.
